description: Closed list of One Horizon workflow task-mode wire values a skill's metadata.compatibility.oneHorizon.taskModes may pick from. These mirror the WorkflowTaskMode values One Horizon workflows already use — do not invent a mode that doesn't exist there (there is no separate "verifier" mode; skills that verify or check work map to "review"). Omit metadata.compatibility.oneHorizon entirely on a skill that isn't bound to a specific One Horizon workflow step.
